title: Reinforcement learning for inverse silhouette design and rapid laser cutting of compact parallelogram quad kirigami prototypes
abstract: arXiv:2605.08098v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Kirigami is an increasingly useful fabrication method to produce shape-programmable metamaterial structures. However, inverse design remains difficult because deployment is nonlinear, and feasible cut layouts must satisfy discrete compatibility rules, avoid overlap, and map one target shape to valid designs. We present RL-Kirigami, an inverse design framework that combines optimal-transport conditional flow matching (OT-CFM) with reinforcement learning to generate compatible ratio fields for compact reconfigurable parallelogram quad kirigami. A marching decoder enforces global geometric compatibility, and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) aligns the generator with nondifferentiable rewards for silhouette matching, feasibility, and ratio-field regularity. translated_title: 面向逆向轮廓设计与紧凑平行四边形四联剪纸原型快速激光切割的强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 剪纸是一种日益实用的制造方法，可用于生产形状可编程的超材料结构。然而，逆向设计仍然困难，原因在于展开过程是非线性的，且可行的切割布局必须满足离散的兼容性规则、避免重叠，并将目标形状映射到有效设计。我们提出了RL-Kirigami，这是一个逆向设计框架，它将最优传输条件流匹配（OT-CFM）与强化学习相结合，为紧凑可重构的平行四边形四联剪纸生成兼容的比率场。行进解码器强制执行全局几何兼容性，群体相对策略优化（GRPO）则使生成器与轮廓匹配、可行性以及比率场正则性等不可微奖励对齐。在程序化生成的目标形状实例中，来自预训练OT-CFM先验的单个样本即达到94.2%的sIoU，优于求解器基线方法，同时……
tldr: 本文提出RL-Kirigami框架，将最优传输条件流匹配与强化学习（GRPO）相结合，实现紧凑平行四边形四联剪纸的逆向轮廓设计，单个样本即达到94.2%的sIoU并优于求解器基线，可支持快速激光切割制作原型。
en_tdlr: RL-Kirigami combines optimal-transport conditional flow matching with reinforcement learning (GRPO) for inverse silhouette design of compact parallelogram quad kirigami, achieving 94.2% sIoU with a single sample, outperforming solver baselines, and enabling rapid laser-cut prototype fabrication.
